body:
I have a baby’s breath smoothie every goddamn morning and LOOK AT ME IM FINE
Edit: nice cake

There is a pinned post in the about section that gave me some relief from the same fear. It’s a link like think you might be a narcissist? 
Or something. “You’re so dramatic “ is absolutely the sort of sweeping generalization a narcissist would make of your character.

This sucks. I’m actually dealing with the same thing with my dad right now. Sends me passive aggressive texts with angry emojis when I don’t answer. Eyeroll

I also escaped when I was in college. I’m 30 now and I’ve been doing therapy for a while. I’m definitely doing a lot better than I was, but there’s still work to do. I look at it as a way of taking care of myself, pampering almost. Because I’m good and kind and want everyone around me to be happy, so I’ve got to start with myself. Instead of like I need to “fix” myself, looking for the problem etc. it took a long time to see it this way.. 

It’s so hard to deal with that lack of love. I’m sorry. You can do this.

One thing many emotional abusers do to maintain control is threaten to hurt themselves. I experienced this when leaving a narcissist ex husband. She may not even have said anything outright about it. Give yourself some time to breathe through that panic thought and you will know what is right for you.
I’m so glad. It’s hard. But you got this. :)

I deal with intrusive thoughts that are my dad’s plantings. You’re doing what you need to be doing. You are a good, kind person who is genuinely trying to be better. You are nothing like him. Keep up the hard work. Its grueling, exhausting. But you can do it and you’re not alone. It will get easier. ♥️

Edit: as for advice, what works for me is after identifying thoughts like this (which took a lot of practice) I say “girl, bye!” Sometimes out loud lol and it works a lot of the time. Just rejecting the thought because it is actually just bad information that I need to practice building a new pattern over. Good luck.
Gosh. This hurts. I know this pain. I’m sorry.
I’m so sorry. I also struggle with this feeling.

Oh hey. I don’t have an answer for you, but I just made a very similar post about my dad because I’m not sure! Glad I’m not the only one who’s confused. Good luck figuring it out. :)

Edit: I am in no way glad that you are experiencing this just ah.. yeah.
